1. (Currently amended) An apparatus for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions in real-time during performance of the documented procedure, comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric __that measures a degree of correspondence between sequential steps in the documented procedure and sequential actions performed by a user__.

2. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment __by comparing a temporal sequence of the demonstrated user actions against a predefined sequence of document actions__.

3. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 2, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface __in response to a determination that the demonstrated user actions correspond to the current step within a threshold confidence level__.

4. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 2, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the current step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the current step based on the identification __by visually distinguishing the current step from other steps in the documented procedure__.

5. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment __by predicting which step should follow based on the alignment of previously demonstrated user actions__.

6. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 5, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface __in advance of the user performing actions corresponding to the next step__.

7. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 5, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the next step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the next step based on the identification __by visually distinguishing the next step from other steps in the documented procedure__.

9. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on common strings in the user interface and the documented procedure __and further based on a comparison of user interface elements accessed during the demonstrated user actions with user interface elements referenced in the documented procedure__.

10. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, further comprising a camera, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for capturing images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions, and wherein said alignment device uses at least some of the captured images to calculate the alignment __by extracting visual features from the captured images and matching those features to visual elements described in the documented procedure__.

11. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure __by weighting the similarity metric according to patterns observed in prior performances of the documented procedure__.

12. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the apparatus further comprises a document action extractor for extracting at least some of the plurality of steps __by parsing the documented procedure to identify discrete, sequential actions__.

13. (Currently amended) An apparatus for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface, the documented procedure having a plurality of steps specified therein, the apparatus comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric __that measures correspondence between sequential steps and sequential user actions__; a highlighting device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for visually highlighting on the user interface at least a portion of a step in the documented procedure based on the alignment computed by said alignment device __to distinguish the highlighted step from non-highlighted steps__; and a scrolling device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for automatically scrolling through each of the plurality of steps of the documented procedure on the user interface based on the alignment computed by said alignment device __to maintain visibility of the current or next step__.

15.
